title: PreMortem AI Scoring Output
description: Schema for LLM-produced scoring data before deterministic severity computation.

risk_id.description: ID of the associated risk item being scored.

llm_score.description: Raw severity score predicted by the LLM (1–5 scale).

probability.description: Likelihood of the risk occurring (0–1 range).

impact.description: Estimated impact of the risk if it occurs (1–5).
